text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, July 1 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 5-6 days, general cargo 4-5 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth. 2 Discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Under repairs, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 31 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 9 product tankers, 9 containers, 2 crude oil, 3 tneb coal, 1 limestone, 1 steel, 1 petcoke, 1 lash barge). 8 Vessels loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering. Cochin - 10 Vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected in port. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Repairs/drydock, 1 general cargo, 2 ferry boats at CSL jetty, 1 tanker at drydock. Chennai (Madras) - 24 Vessels due of which 6 coal, 2 general, 4 fertiliser, 3 iron ore, 7 containers, 1 quartz, 2 oil. Delays, coal/coke, others 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, no delay for iron ore. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Mormugao - Four vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Kandla - 14 Vessels due, 10-20 days berthing delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 13 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 loading in stream, 3 discharging at berth, 1 discharging in stream. 3 Tankers, 12 vessels waiting. Mangalore - Nine vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berth, 1 under repair. Jawaharlal Nehru - Vessels due, 1 fertiliser, 6 tankers/iron ore. Delays expected, 18-20 days for fertiliser, 1-2 days for tankers. 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Paradip - Five vessels due, up to 1 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Tuticorin - Four vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay at present. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 awaiting orders. Visakhapatnam - 15 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 15 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to load at inner hbour berth.

MALAYSIA, July 2 - Port Klang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 5 Vessels alongside, 2 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 5 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Bulk liquid terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 2 days waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 4 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, none waiting, no waiting time. Bulk liquid terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, none waiting, no waiting time.

PHILIPPINES, June 30 - Manila - South harbour - 16 Vessels discharging at berth, 7 discharging at anchorage. 17 Waiting at outside anchorage to discharge, 1 other vessel. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres 2-3 days, draft more than 9 metres and loa more than 140 metres 3-5 days.

SOUTH KOREA, July 1 - Inchon - 61 Vessels in port (39 berthed, 22 anchored) of which 7 logs, 6 corn, 5 general cargo, 4 cars, 3 each steel, ply, 2 each pig iron, containers, coils, 1 each scrap, soybean, raw sugar, bananas, woodcp. Anchored, 5 cars, 4 containers, 3 each corn, general cargo, 1 each logs, soybean, tapioca, wheat blending pellets, coils, steel, palm oil, approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 153 Vessels in port (42 berthed, 111 anchored including 55 laid up of which 29 general cargo, 8 containers, 3 each scrap, coal. 56 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 27 Vessels in port (24 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 8 steel products, 3 steel scrap, 1 magnesite, 1 logs. 11 Vessels loading steel, 3 awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 26 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 1 coal, feed meal, logs, cement, chemical, phosphate rock, raw sugar, zinc concentrate, copper concentrate, corn, mixed xylene, propane. Loading, 6 general cargo, 1 each fertiliser, steel pipes, cyclo-hexane, gas oil. 4 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3-4 days delay expected. Masan - 23 Vessels in port (18 berthed, 5 anchored) of which discharging, 7 scrap, 2 tapioca, 1 each talc powder, pulp, containers, bananas, structural. Loading, 1 scale, 1 cars. 5 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3 days delay expected.

SRI LANKA, July 1 - Colombo - Nine container/feeders due. Delays expected 1-2 days for general cargo, 2-3 days for containers (feeder). 3 Essential services loading at berth. Discharging at berth, 2 bagged sugar, 13 container vessels, 3 essential services, 1 lpg, 1 general cargo, 3 bagged fertiliser, 2 bagged cement. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 5 container (feeders), 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged fertiliser. 1 Vessel under repair, in drydock, 6 others, 2 awaiting orders, 1 crew change. Labour shortage persists, delays in berthing/unberthing (pilotage) on breakbulk conventional vessels. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - Two vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.

TAIWAN, June 30 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain, iron ore, steel 3 days, coal 8 days. Kaohsiung - Nine vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 6 days, iron/coal (csc berth) 4 days, coal/scrap (public berth) 7 days, steel 2 days. Taichung - Eight vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 7-8 days, iron ore, coal, steel and others 1-2 days, scrap 1 day. July 1 - Kaohsiung - Vessels in port 10 containers, 3 tankers, 2 grain, 3 other bulkers, 28 generals, 10 buoys. Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 5 generals, 5 days berthing delay for generals.
THAILAND, July 1 - Bangkok - 73 Vessels in port of which 6 containers, 67 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 2 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
